mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT r.* FROM studyroom_runs r JOIN study_rooms s ON s.id=r.room_id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} AND current_run_id=#{runId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE id=#{fragmentId} AND run_id=#{runId}
SELECT region_json FROM studyroom_lecture_regions WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision} AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT id FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE unit_id=#{unitId} AND fragment_order>#{fragmentOrder} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_lecture_regions SET deleted=TRUE WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision}
